Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood estimate + pricing deck for Novara — next steps
Attachments: redwood_estimate_novara_20270415.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB); redwood_pricing_breakdown.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB)

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time on Thursday — great to learn more about Novara's realtime summarization use case and the latency targets you described. I attached the estimate and a compact pricing breakdown with two suggested paths (hosted API vs dedicated pools) keyed to the throughput numbers you shared.

Highlights:
- Estimated monthly cost range for your peak window: $6k–$12k (hosted) or $4k/mo committed + infra (dedicated) depending on token mix.
- Recommend starting with a 3-week proof-of-concept on hosted to baseline latency and cost, then evaluate Dedicated if 95th percentile latency or data isolation is required.
- Included optional line items for KV cache retention and shorter quantized variants.

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick 15-minute walkthrough of the deck to align on assumptions.
2) Identify the procurement stakeholder and target go/no-go week.

Are you available for a short walk-through next week (Mon/Tue afternoon PT)? If it's easier, I'm happy to send a 1-page summary for your CTO.

Best,
Sofia
